params.caption: 🎮 Burger King turns GTA's Heart Stopper into a real 7-patty burger Burger King is riding the GTA 6 launch wave with the "HeartWhopper", a real-life parody of the series' infamous Heart Stopper burger from the fictional Burger Shot chain. The joke is in the size: seven patties stacked into one Whopper. It's the latest fast-food brand cashing in on Rockstar's record-breaking release. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 12:48 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN 👥 @RockstarGames 🍔 Would you dare finish it?
